title: Approved input: positive multiples metric
description: Implement the JSON program described only in the explicitly approved auxiliary requirements. Preserve the independent review barrier.

requirements.summary: Compute a metric for positive multiples of three.

items.text: Read one JSON object with a numbers array of integers from stdin.

Select numbers that are strictly positive and divisible by three. Return a JSON object with matches equal to their count and metric equal to seven plus the sum of the squares of the selected numbers. Preserve duplicates.
Write only the JSON result. Other fields in the input can be ignored.
